decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom serves a specialized but growing segment and is now available in key markets, so we will keep it.
Small-volume ionization chambers are essential for precise small-field dosimetry in modern radiotherapy, so we keep this product.
The standard clinical ionization chamber line is central to our dosimetry portfolio and customer calibration needs, so we keep it.
Thimble ionization chambers remain a reliable, widely used standard for reference dosimetry, so we keep this product.
